root_cause: The only remaining 'Start een nieuwe reis' button was bound late inside initialize(). Any exception earlier in initialization could leave the visible button with no click handler.
startNewTrip() navigated only after clearDraft() and resetState(). If reset/persistence/rendering threw first, the click appeared to do nothing.
resetState() used several unguarded DOM/persistence side effects, so an unrelated UI problem could abort the new-trip action.
fix: The critical Start button is now bound first in initialize(), before other setup.
A delegated document-level fallback also handles the button if the DOM node is replaced or initialization is partial.
The event is explicitly marked so the direct and delegated handlers cannot fire twice.
Planner navigation happens before reset side effects.
Nonessential reset UI/persistence operations are guarded so they cannot block navigation.
